collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page (English) around 10:36 Beijing time. Credits table, three-part pricing and the embedded RSC payload only. Re-verification of the round1 row; no leaderboard or score data.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. One existing paid model row re-verified (per-model credits $20 -> $100). No leaderboard/score changes, no OpenCode Go changes, no shared-pool changes, no new model rows.

supersedes.relation: re-verification of the same row; round1 is kept unchanged under the append-only rule
supersedes.unchanged: three-part price cached/input/output = $0.06/$0.30/$0.90, shared monthly pool $70, modelId, vendor, minPlan, confidence, basis

adopted.cacheWriteNote: No cache-write price listed in the official table.

observedCredits.promoMarkerDetail: No 'was', 'through' or creditDeal wording present anywhere in the credits presentation at collection time, so the value is not rendered as a temporary or limited-time credit deal.
observedCredits.reasonAdopted: CONVENTIONS and the recorded DECISIONS precedent treat a credit value carrying no end marker as the standing tier. The page now shows an unqualified $100, so $100 is adopted rather than the previous $20.
observedCredits.precedent: Same rule previously applied to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Command Code GOAT ($15 -> $60) and to OpenCode Go V4.1 Flash, both adopted as permanent once the page dropped the limited-time marking.

rscPayload.interpretation: budgetUsd is a flat 100 and the single budget step raises the budget to 100 on 2026-10-15T12:30Z with no subsequent down-step and no end date, i.e. the step is now live and is not a temporary promotion.
rscPayload.changeFromRound1: At the 2026-10-15 ~14:05 Beijing capture the $100 step was not yet live, so round1 kept the adopted row at the steady-state $20 and recorded the step as evidence only. It is live at this collection.

freeVariant.reason: Free variant rows are excluded from the adopted set under the existing project rule; unchanged by this collection.

budgetStep.reason: The 2026-10-15T12:30Z $100 step is not treated as a separate promotion to be excluded; it is the live standing budget and is the same $100 already shown in the credits table, so it is captured as evidence rather than an extra tier.

sharedPoolUnchanged.note: Shared pool value and every other GOAT row are unchanged. This row is now capped by the shared $70 pool rather than by its own per-model credits, so any future pool increase would raise it again.

unchangedScope: No leaderboard or score data touched.
No other Command Code GOAT row touched.
